scope: P11 bounded native local video-only overlay relay; no claim of full overlay/media acceptance
behavior: Reuses the existing passive HUD BrowserWindow. Only its exact current mainFrame and the exact current application mainFrame participate; action/composer windows and subframes cannot open/send/acknowledge.

The main opens an immutable max4/max2-kind tile lease after actual HUD listener readiness, native visibility, enabled policy and camera/screen opt-ins. Separate bounded lease metadata precedes SDP offers. No SDP/ICE/keys are logged; no Room/network/service credentials or game injection are introduced.

Video-only pure contract validates local-host SDP/ICE, direction, source-to-MID mapping and description relations. MAIN sends offer; HUD sends answer. HUD early ICE is queued at most64, each direction accepts at most128 candidates per lease; opens capped10/10seconds and viewports120/second. Viewports are source/session/revision-bound, max1920x1080/60; invisible must use0/0/0.

Native session/revision/window generation and exact frame identities fence stale sources. Valid kind preference revocation is projected synchronously before native repaint and retires the full lease; end is emitted to both live endpoints. Delivery errors return false and retire.

Native hide ends the lease but retains same-frame installed listeners. Availability becomes non-ready/hidden, re-show allows a fresh lease. Navigation/crash/close and explicit receiver-ready false revoke readiness and generation; in-flight navigation has no available HUD target until did-finish-load. Stale old-window events cannot revoke a replacement.
Media-only HUD allocates a passive region at most320DIP, bounded by work area. Compatibility remains passive/read-only and does not grant input or disable the media privacy fences.
